adapter.name: ten
adapter.license: Apache-2.0 with additional noncompetition/use restrictions; see upstream LICENSE
adapter.alignment: Uncalibrated native streaming score; no timestamp compensation
adapter.input_scaling: normalized float32 converted to native PCM scale
adapter.provenance: Externally supplied library; hash recorded, source correspondence unverified

methodology.tail_policy: drop incomplete native frame; exclude uncovered grid
methodology.latency: simulated acquisition time, excludes measured computation
methodology.timing: includes causal resampling, dispatch, buffering, inference; excludes WAV read/reset; one pass
methodology.memory: isolated backend process peak RSS, includes full corpus trace storage; not model-only RAM
